# Other resources

When you filled out the 'Expression of Interest' form, you agreed to our data policy, which you can read again here: [GoodGrain General Data Protection Regulation (PDF)](documents/GDPdocument.pdf){target="_blank"}

The results from the perennial rye flour laboratory analysis can be accessed here: [GoodGrain Lab Results (PDF)](documents/LabResults2025.pdf){target="_blank"}

The perennial rye variety was developed in Germany and is described in [this scientific publication from 1986](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1439-037X.1986.tb00077.x). It is a rather dense piece of text.
